1436-4091-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Aphetto Alchemist doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-4091-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1734-4681-8095.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3562-5231-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

3249-3967-4647-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

5687-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5687-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
5687-6798-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Umbral Collar Zealot.

967-3809-4365-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1661-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
1661-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-6752.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3365-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-3389-5478-5954-6751.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-3174-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
2438-3174-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

950-1636-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
950-1636-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

225-343-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-343-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3967-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-3967-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

553-2706.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Wheel of Fortune by paying {2}{R}, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

282-4636-5159.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Delina.
282-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get four energy counters.
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Mishra's Warform that is tapped and attacking.
When the nonlegendary Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it, the legendary Mishra's Warform, and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get six energy counters.
Activate a Mishra's Warform by paying eight energy counters and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1283-2701-2825-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2701-2825-3525.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dark Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.

2232-2785-3558-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Mardu Warshrieker onto the battlefield.
Mardu Warshrieker and Cloudstone Curio each trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Warshrieker trigger, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mardu Warshrieker to your hand.
Repeat.

1303-2743-4499-4875.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Biovisionary.
Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-2 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
